newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HIH WINTERTHUR CANNOT EXPLAIN SHARE PRICE.
newsitem.headline: HIH WINTERTHUR CANNOT EXPLAIN SHARE PRICE.

text.p: Swiss-controlled insurer HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Friday that it could not explain the recent rise in its share price.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, the company also said it expected operating profit before abnormal items and tax in the first six months of calendar 1997 to rise more than 15 percent due to changed accounting standards.
It said unrealised gains from its equity portfolio would now be treated as profits in the upcoming results, a fact which the company said most analysts who followed the stock were well aware of.
